about.headline: Designing and engineering intentional, noise-free web platforms.
paragraphs: Frontend-focused developer crafting polished web experiences with a practical backend edge.
Lately, I'm putting more of my energy into generative AI, exploring how intelligent tools can turn ambitious ideas into useful products.

aiQuestions.question: Who is Joshua?
aiQuestions.answer: Joshua M. Madulid (@envydoes) is a graduating BS Information Technology student at Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology (NEUST). He is a full-stack developer and UI/UX designer with proven experience delivering live production systems like the SumEste Portal (sum-este-portal.digital), specializing in PHP, MySQL, modern web tooling, Docker, and AI-assisted workflows.

aiQuestions.question: Is Joshua available for work or collaboration?
aiQuestions.answer: Yes! Joshua is open to collaborations, freelance projects, and full-time opportunities in Full-Stack Web Development, Frontend/Backend, and UI/UX Design. He's available for remote, hybrid, or on-site arrangements. You can reach him at madulidjoshuam@gmail.com.

aiQuestions.question: What technologies and stack does Joshua know?
aiQuestions.answer: Joshua specializes in Backend (PHP, Node.js, RESTful APIs, MySQL), Frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3), DevOps/Cloud (Docker, Coolify, AWS, GitHub Actions), and modern AI engineering tools (Google Gemini, Claude Code, OpenAI).

aiQuestions.question: What are Joshua's key projects?
aiQuestions.answer: Joshua's flagship project is the SumEste Portal (sum-este-portal.digital) — a live resident tracking and community administration platform. He also engineered the Momms Inventory Management System, the TatakPH mobile app, Aurora tourism platform, and designed the comprehensive ATOM AI conversing app.

aiQuestions.question: What certifications does Joshua hold?
aiQuestions.answer: Joshua holds 12 verified credentials, including the prestigious Google AI Professional Certificate (8 Courses) on Coursera, Cisco Networking Academy's JavaScript Essentials 2, TESDA/Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals, and multiple enterprise architecture, API integration, and cybersecurity certifications from UpskillTechPH.

aiQuestions.question: How can I contact Joshua?
aiQuestions.answer: You can reach Joshua directly by email at madulidjoshuam@gmail.com, via GitHub at github.com/envydoes, or on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/joshuamadulid.
